title: EP01 — 늦게 돌아오는 결과
intent: Carry the no-obvious-answer field-drama standard from the opening into inspection, reporting, TBM change control, restart, stop-work culture and instruction-chain consequences.
rules: A later choice must trade speed, certainty, authority, evidence quality or trust rather than offer a clean textbook answer.
Every major choice gets an immediate consequence beat before the delayed return event.
Delayed return events reveal what the earlier choice taught the site to do next.
Records, photos and verbal instructions are partial evidence whose meaning depends on time and context.
Workers and supervisors remember how the player handled earlier ambiguity; dialogue should sound like that memory is present.

arcs.question: Can a corrective action be both physically true and accurately represented while work is still moving?
What can be responsibly reported before every account and timestamp agrees?
How does a site preserve changed conditions, restart criteria and willingness to report under schedule pressure?
